annotations.description: Rolling 24h input tokens through the Cloudflare AI Gateway. jevgrep's jev model is counted from the response body, because its gateway log records report 0 usage (cf2otel CFO-0086); every other model uses gen_ai.usage.input_tokens. Normal days are 15-40M. The 2026-10-19 spike was 355M, almost all from jg calls in loop lanes. Check which loops are running jg heavily, using the agent-history catalogue.
annotations.summary: AI Gateway input tokens over the last 24h: {{ humanize $values.B.Value }} (threshold 150M)

model.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="cf2otel"} | event_name="gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details" | gen_ai_request_model="jev" | json in="result.usage.input_tokens" | unwrap in [24h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time({service_name="cf2otel"} | event_name="cloudflare.ai_gateway.request" | gen_ai_request_model!="jev" | unwrap gen_ai_usage_input_tokens [24h])) or vector(0))
